## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the related issue or architecture decision when applicable.

## Validation

- [ ] Work is on a distinct `feature/` or `fix/` branch.
- [ ] Relevant checks passed; actual commands/results are listed below.
- [ ] Dependency and asset licenses were reviewed; required notices were updated if needed.
- [ ] Privacy, keyboard accessibility, and constrained-network behavior were considered where relevant.
- [ ] Documentation and known limitations reflect the final implementation.

Include screenshots for visible changes and distinguish direct-connection tests from live TURN verification.
